items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand
items.claim: In the text, the LORD tells Moses that when he returns to Egypt he must perform before Pharaoh all the wonders the LORD has given him power to do.
items.action: instructs Moses to perform wonders before Pharaoh
items.mechanism: divine command (the power to do wonders is given to Moses)

items.quote: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
items.claim: In the text, the LORD says ahead of time that He will harden Pharaoh's heart so that Pharaoh will not let the people go.
items.action: declares He will harden Pharaoh's heart
items.mechanism: divine hardening of the heart causes Pharaoh to refuse to let the people go
